## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete change and responsible developer.

## Task and acceptance

Task/issue ID, planned week, branch and affected owners:
Acceptance criteria and demonstrated results:

## Contract and integration impact

List affected routes, settings, migrations and consumers. Link the accepted contract
or identify proposed changes and source conflicts. Identify Week 4 versus later scope.

## Validation

List exact commands/results and runtime versions. Separate passed, failed, skipped,
blocked and unexecuted checks. Use synthetic data; redact private information.
Documentation validation does not prove business integration or deployment.

## Review

- [ ] Changes stay within assigned ownership.
- [ ] Teammate feature edits have Isaac's prior approval.
- [ ] Contract/schema mappings and dependent-owner reviews are recorded.
- [ ] Configuration and actual setup commands are documented without credentials.
- [ ] Applicable checks in docs/code-review.md have evidence.
- [ ] Docs describe actual behavior and label proposals/placeholders.
- [ ] Migration compatibility/recovery impact is documented where applicable.

## Handoff and release

Name the next reviewer, blockers and one- or two-day continuation tasks.
State staging/production impact and required release decision; PR merge alone is
not a production release. Link demo/recovery evidence when this PR deploys.
